notes.title: Controller support added
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31665583/d548449ccfc37c9bf0b7a6bf1a1c257015047f28.gif[/img]

Good News!

Now you can play [b]The Quest for the BIG KEY[/b] with your Gamepads and Controllers. It even works in [b]Big Picture Mode[/b] and on the [b]Steam Link[/b].

Note: On [b]Steam Link[/b] the Controllers need to be using this Template: 
[b]BIG KEY - Steam Controller BIG KEY config[/b]

Please let me know if that works for you :)

Greetings

hOSHI*
